reviews.rationale: Sequential selected-row comparison shows a mixed but deteriorating operating picture: consolidated GAAP revenue declined while processing and total operating expenses rose, pushing operating income into an operating loss. A restructuring and other charges line appears only in the event-period extract with no baseline comparator, so its contribution to the expense increase cannot be separated from other cost movement. The narrower net loss is driven by a much smaller other-expense drag and a smaller tax benefit, not by operating improvement, and the tax line is a benefit in both periods, so it is not evidence of reduced tax burden. Segment detail is mixed: B2B Services revenue rose while Consumer Services and Money Movement revenue fell, and the segment-to-GAAP reconciliation remains small and stable. All comparisons are sequential displayed-value arithmetic on selected rows, not year-over-year, not non-GAAP, and not causal. Missing evidence includes the full income statement and expense detail, non-GAAP reconciliations, guidance and realized-versus-guided comparison, segment operating profit, cash flow, and any management explanation of the revenue and cost moves. Research state held for review pending those items.
